ITEM 1 | Bright red, glossy, moist pieces with tiny pale seeds on the surface; several halved and wedge-shaped pieces (about 3-4 cm across, 1.5-2.5 cm tall) placed on the upper right and center-left of the plate, with one small heart-shaped half on top | 65
ITEM 2 | Small dark blue-black spheres about 1 cm across with smooth, slightly glossy skin; three visible scattered near the strawberry pieces and one on the left side of the plate | 4
ITEM 3 | Bright red-pink, moist, firm cubes about 2-3.5 cm per side with cut flat faces and sharp edges, some with small dark seeds embedded; about ten pieces scattered across the right and center of the plate, plus a small rectangular stick (about 3.5 x 1.5 cm) at lower left | 120
